title.narrative: Life-saving food aid for the affected population in Yemen for the year 2023

description.narrative: (36,237) families for a period of 14 months, with a total of 6 distribution cycles (one for every two months), in addition to emergency distribution

Securing (179,982) food baskets to be distributed to the affected families of the displaced and the host community most in need and who suffer from food insecurity, who are classified within the fourth stage of the Integrated Food Security Phase Classification (IPC) in nine governorates with food aid to meet the needs of family members of basic foodstuffs

The project targets the affected families of the displaced and the host community who are most in need and who suffer from food insecurity, who are classified under the fourth stage of the Integrated Food Security Phase Classification (IPC).
